tasks.title: WP-M0-01 Repository bootstrap. Deliverables: git repository initialised (GitButler workspace per user rules); first commit contains the docs/spec/work/tools already present; .gitignore covers target/, node_modules/, __pycache__/, .ruff_cache/, .DS_Store, model weights and local state (work/steps is NOT ignored); rust-toolchain.toml pinned to 1.98.1 with rustfmt+clippy components; rustfmt.toml; clippy.toml (allow-{unwrap,expect,panic}-in-tests = true; non-test unwrap/expect/panic are denied by the crate-level `#![deny(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]` required by ARC-003 — `disallowed-methods` cannot exempt test code, verified with clippy 0.1.98 on 2026-10-26); Apache-2.0 LICENSE, NOTICE, CONTRIBUTING (Conventional Commits, WP workflow), SECURITY.md (reporting policy), CHANGELOG.md skeleton. Acceptance (must pass): git status --porcelain | head -1 >/dev/null && rustc --version | grep -q 1.98 && cargo fmt --version && cargo clippy --version
tasks.system_prompt: Read AGENTS.md and docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md first. Work ONLY inside these paths: .gitignore, .editorconfig, LICENSE, NOTICE, rust-toolchain.toml, rustfmt.toml, clippy.toml, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md. Spec refs: ADR-002, ADR-022, ARC-003. Expand this work package into 2-5 minute steps before coding.

tasks.title: WP-M0-02 Workspace, pinned dependencies, cargo-deny, crate skeletons. Deliverables: root Cargo.toml: workspace members = crates/*, adapters/*, bench/*; [workspace.dependencies] pins EVERY third-party crate planned in docs/evidence/crate-versions.md (re-verified with cargo add --dry-run; deviations appended to the evidence file); one skeleton crate per entry of tools/layers.toml (lib.rs with crate docs + #![forbid(unsafe_code)] (except gap-s1) + #![deny(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic, clippy::todo, clippy::unimplemented)]); gap-testkit as dev-only crate; bench/routebench, bench/gapbench and bench/enrichment (package enrichment-bench) as bin stubs; gap-server/gap-cli as bin crates; module stubs: run `python3 tools/wp.py modules` and create every listed module as an empty file/dir with its `mod` declaration in the crate's lib.rs/main.rs, so no later WP ever edits lib.rs (AGENT-GUIDE §6); deny.toml (licenses allow-list, advisories deny, bans: duplicate axum/hyper/prost/tower, crate openjev; BSL only under feature store-surreal); fuzz/ cargo-fuzz project with autobins=false and one stub target per planned fuzz target (fuzz_gapql_parse, fuzz_ngc_decode, fuzz_extract_openapi, fuzz_extract_proto, fuzz_extract_graphql, fuzz_extract_sql, fuzz_extract_mcp, fuzz_sanitize, fuzz_cursor_decode, fuzz_policy_input). Acceptance (must pass): cargo build --workspace --locked && cargo tree -d --workspace | python3 -c "import sys,re; t=sys.stdin.read(); bad=[n for n in ('axum','hyper','prost','tower') if len(set(re.findall(r'^'+n+r' v(\S+)',t,re.M)))>1]; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)" && cargo deny check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

tasks.title: WP-M0-03 Pin external specifications (MCP, A2A, GraphQL, GraphQL-over-HTTP). Deliverables: third_party/MANIFEST.toml with url, retrieved_at, sha256, license for: MCP spec 2026-07-28 (+2025-11-25 for outbound compat), A2A v1.0 a2a.proto + spec text, GraphQL spec edition used, GraphQL-over-HTTP spec, graphql-sse protocol; third_party/specs/*: vendored copies (or checksummed excerpts where licensing forbids copying) and a SPEC-NOTES.md listing every place spec/09 says 'verify against upstream' with the verified answer (MCP _meta keys, MRTR/input-required shape, A2A task state names); docs/evidence/crate-versions.md updated with the GraphQL edition and any contradictions found; Follow work/context/m0-03-brief.md (binding): the sources are staged by the reviewer under .local/specs-staging (no network for the agent), third_party/specs/<bundle>/ holds byte-identical copies, MANIFEST.toml lists every file with the sha256 of the staging log, SPEC-NOTES.md answers Q-1..Q-18 with citations and lists every deferral to upstream, third_party/README.md explains re-verification and licences. Acceptance (must pass): python3 -c "import tomllib;m=tomllib.load(open('third_party/MANIFEST.toml','rb'));assert len(m['spec'])>=5" && test -f third_party/specs/SPEC-NOTES.md

Acceptance (must pass): python3 -c "import yaml" 2>/dev/null || true && test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml && just --list | grep -q verify

tasks.title: WP-M0-06 Protobuf pipeline and gap-proto crate. Deliverables: build.rs using protox + tonic-prost-build compiling proto/gap/ngc/v1/ngc.proto and proto/gap/gateway/v1/gateway.proto (no system protoc required); vendored A2A proto compiled behind feature a2a; descriptor golden test: SHA-256 of the FileDescriptorSet committed; changing a field number or name fails the test unless the golden is updated in the same commit with a CHANGELOG entry; wire-compat test: encode/decode round-trip for every message with proptest-generated values; Follow work/context/m0-06-brief.md (binding): the build tooling is vendored offline (protox, tonic-prost-build, prost-reflect, sha2), the A2A proto is compiled from third_party/specs/a2a-v1.0.1 with the googleapis includes of third_party/specs/googleapis-646596e286b4, the golden is coupled to crates/gap-proto/CHANGELOG.md, the round-trip test covers every message through a registry, and the handoff lists the required mutation checks. Acceptance (must pass): cargo nextest run -p gap-proto && cargo clippy -p gap-proto --all-targets -- -D warnings
tasks.system_prompt: Read AGENTS.md and docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md first. Work ONLY inside these paths: crates/gap-proto/**, proto/**. Spec refs: NGC-001, NGC-004, CMP-020, CMP-021, CMP-022, ADR-002. Expand this work package into 2-5 minute steps before coding.

tasks.title: WP-M0-07 Spec traceability tool. Deliverables: tools/spec_trace.py: extracts requirement ids from spec/*.md (bold **XXX-nnn** bullets, plus table-defined INV-nn and TM-nn ids; a requirement is a MUST if its text contains MUST/MUST NOT); scans crates/**, adapters/**, tests/**, conformance/** for 'spec: <ID>' markers; reports MUSTs without tests, tests with unknown ids; modes --warn (default until M1 exit), --strict, --milestone Mx (limits to ids referenced by that milestone's WPs); unit tests with fixtures. Acceptance (must pass): python3 -m unittest tools.test_spec_trace && python3 tools/spec_trace.py --warn | tail -3
tasks.system_prompt: Read AGENTS.md and docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md first. Work ONLY inside these paths: tools/spec_trace.py, tools/test_spec_trace.py. Spec refs: ARC-004, ADR-022. Expand this work package into 2-5 minute steps before coding.

tasks.title: WP-M0-08 gap-core foundations: ids, errors, clock, secrets, config, context. Deliverables: id newtypes (TenantId, BranchId, BranchUid, OperationId, GroupId, TaskId, ProposalId) with validation + serde + proptest; GapError + ErrorCode enum covering spec/02 §10 exactly (serialize as extensions.code), retry metadata, suggestion payloads; conversion to/from NgcError; Clock trait (system + manual test clock), Secret<T> (Debug/Display redacted, zeroize), tracing/OTel init helper, RequestContext, Budget, TraceCtx; Snapshot data model per spec/01 §4 (types only; Arc<apollo_compiler::Schema>) and the shared traits declared here: ElementSearch, Embedder, DiscoveryService, GraphqlEngine, HttpModule (so higher layers can be wired without upward dependencies, ARC-007); Config: gap.toml schema (serde + schemars -> docs/config.schema.json), env override GAP_*__*, unknown keys rejected, secret:// references. Acceptance (must pass): cargo nextest run -p gap-core && cargo clippy -p gap-core --all-targets -- -D warnings && RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p gap-core --no-deps
